title: Sajjad Ko Bay Mout Yeh Ghum Maar Gaya Hai
body:
Bay Parda Haram Saath Hain (x2) Aur Shaam Chala Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Naa Maar Sakina Ko Tamachay Ay Sittamgar (x2)
Ehsaas E Yateemi He Bari Sakht Saaza Hai (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay Shimar E Laien Kis Pay Tu Barsata Hai Kooray (x2)
Abid Tou Bari Dair Say Bay Hoosh Parha Hai (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Looh Agai Zindan Say Rayha Ho Kay Sakina (x2)
Sajjad Kay Seenay Say Jo Aik Laasha Laga Hai (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Shikwa Nahi Zindan Say Koi Bint E Ali Ko (x2)
Kia Kum Hai Kay Deewaron Nay Parda Tou Kiya Hai (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sir Ghazi Ka Tharra Kay Girra Nook E Senna Say (x2)
Shaiyad Sir E Zainab Ko Khula Dekh Liya Hai (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehtin Thi Yeh Sughra Huwa Kia Karbobala Main (x2)
Qasid Teray Daman Pay Lahoo Kis Ka Laga Hai (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Maqtal Say Chali Aati Hai Zahra Ki Sadain (x2)
Ya Rab Yeh Kahan Ka Ka’afla Salar Chala Hai (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhayta Hay Shab O Rooz Lahoo Ankhon Ab Tak (x2)
Sajjad Nay Tasheer Ka Wooh Zehar Piya Hai (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Zanjeeron Ki Aawaz Ubharti Rahi Shabar (x2)
Is Qaidi Ko Kia Roog Hai Kioun Jaag Raha Hai (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Darbare E Jafakar May Youn Aatin Hain Zainab (x2)
Chehray Pay Lahoo Aun O Mauhammed Ka Malla  Hai (x2)
